alkylation_reagent.evidence: After cooling, 15l of 100l iodoacetamide (IAM) solution was added to the fractions and stored for 30 min at room temperature to alkylate the proteins.

cleavage_agent.evidence: Sample preparation for label-free mass spectrometry-based proteomics involves digesting samples (overnight) with Trypsin Gold (Promega, V528A) in S-Trap Spin Columns, followed by purification using OLIGO R3 Reverse beads in acetonitrile (ACN).

instrument.value: Thermo Scientific Q Exactive HF hybrid quadrupole-Orbitrap mass spectrometer
instrument.evidence: The resulting peptides were dried and subjected to mass spectrometry data acquisition using a Thermo Scientific Q Exactive HF hybrid quadrupole-Orbitrap mass spectrometer equipped with a Dionex Corporation UltiMate 3000 Rapid Separation LC nanosystem at Manchester University.
